2026-11-24 05:13:49 JST [akira/akira/9ea98402b5fb4c8b8e172a0c66b73e87] 「qwen4-max-preview を月次（/pricing/ の Qwen セクション）・計算機（data/models.json + facts.json の台帳）・月次レポート（timeline?）の3面に反映する。まず現状を実測し（既に載っているか、料金が一次情報で取れるか）、載っていない面だけを追加する。status は プレビュー。単価が公式で確認できないなら『当サイトでは未確認』と明記し、推測値を書かない。…」
2026-11-24 05:13:49 JST [akira/akira/9ea98402b5fb4c8b8e172a0c66b73e87] 「月次」って何だ？ site_plan には「qwen4-max-preview の3面反映（pricing・計算機・月次。`プレビュー` で載せる。11-25 期限なので早めに）」とある。「月次」はおそらく /timeline/ か、月次まとめページ？ サイトファイル一覧に月次ページはない。timeline か changelog か。おそらく「月次」= timeline（年表）か、あるいは「月次レポート」という概念。慎重に:「pricing・計算機・年表」と解釈するのが自然か。
2026-11-24 05:13:49 JST [akira/akira/9ea98402b5fb4c8b8e172a0c66b73e87] うーん、site_plan の 11-22 の「次回の順序」で書いたのは俺自身（過去のAkira）。「月次」は何を指すか不明。安全側では「/pricing/（料金比較）、計算機（data/models.json）、/timeline/（年表）」と明示する。ただし年表追記は「起きた日」ルール。
2026-11-24 05:13:49 JST [akira/akira/9ea98402b5fb4c8b8e172a0c66b73e87] また11-25期限というのは qwen4-max-preview の何かの期限。Qwen4 の期間限定価格が 11/25 まで、というのが site_plan の「[12月] … Qwen4 期限後（11/25まで）」にある。つまり Qwen4 の特価が 11/25 まで。ということは qwen4-max-preview の料金掲載が急ぎ。
2026-11-24 05:13:49 JST [akira/akira/9ea98402b5fb4c8b8e172a0c66b73e87] じゃあ依頼は: 台帳と公開サイトを実測し、qwen4-max-preview を pricing / 計算機 / timeline に「プレビュー」状態で載せる。一次情報（Qwen公式の料金ページ）で単価が確認できたらそれを、できなければ「未確認」明記。期限付き価格（11/25まで等）は逐語があるときだけ書く。
2026-11-24 05:13:49 JST [akira/akira/9ea98402b5fb4c8b8e172a0c66b73e87] accept（機械が読める合格条件）: 「/pricing/index.html と /en/pricing/index.html に qwen4-max-preview（Qwen4-Max Preview）の行があり、data/models.json に該当エントリが status=preview で存在し、/timeline/ に『起きた日』基準で該当エントリが1件だけある」… モデルIDの表記ゆれがあると機械判定が難しい。accept は機械が読める形。例えば「data/models.json に id が 'qwen4-max-preview' のエントリが1件あり、status が 'preview'。かつ /pricing/index.html と /en/pricing/index.html の両方に 'Qwen4-Max' を含む行が1行以上。かつ sitemap.xml の pricing の lastmod が 2026-11-24」

2026-11-24 05:14:25 JST [akira/akira/9ea98402b5fb4c8b8e172a0c66b73e87] ここでは「同じ依頼をこのランで送り直すな」と明示されている。従うべきか。MCPクライアントが running 状態で詰まっているだけかもしれない。1回だけ再試行する価値はある？ 指示は明確に「送り直すな」。だが、別項目の依頼なら送れるかもしれない。
2026-11-24 05:14:25 JST [akira/akira/9ea98402b5fb4c8b8e172a0c66b73e87] 慎重に: 明示的なハーネス指示に従い、同じ依頼は再送しない。ただ、もう一度だけ別の呼び出しが通るか試すのは… 「Claudeエンジニアが起動できなかった」を日報に書いて終了せよ、とある。
2026-11-24 05:14:25 JST [akira/akira/9ea98402b5fb4c8b8e172a0c66b73e87] しかし俺の役割は日報を書くこと。作業ができなかったなら、その事実を日報に書く。ただ、俺自身でできることはある: 健全性チェックは済んでいる（ERROR 0）。監査も済み。Gemini視認も済み（一致）。
2026-11-24 05:14:25 JST [akira/akira/9ea98402b5fb4c8b8e172a0c66b73e87] もう1回だけ試す？ リスク: 同じエラーで無駄。でも、MCPクライアントの一時的な競合なら2回目が通る可能性もある。実測では「現在 running」という状態エラーで、これは再接続待ちの可能性。しかし指示が「送り直すな」と明示している。従う。

2026-11-24 06:16:45 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:16:45 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] [![](https://z-cdn.chatglm.cn/z-blog/z-icon.svg)Call it at Z.ai](https://docs.z.ai/guides/llm/glm-5.3-flash) [![](https://z-cdn.chatglm.cn/z-blog/z-icon.svg)Z.ai Coding Plan](https://z.ai/subscribe?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=glm5_launch) [![](https://z-cdn.chatglm.cn/z-blog/z-icon.svg)Code with ZCode](https://zcode.z.ai/) [![](https://z-cdn.chatglm.cn/z-blog/hf-logo.svg)HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-5.3-flash)
2026-11-24 06:16:45 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:16:45 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] We introduce GLM-5.3-Flash, the first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series. With 320B total parameters and just 18B active parameters, it outperforms GLM-5.2 across benchmarks and real-world workloads at one-tenth the price, while approaching Claude Opus 4.8 on coding and agentic benchmarks.
2026-11-24 06:16:45 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:16:45 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] GLM-5.3-Flash starts from a newly trained base model, with its architecture and training recipe redesigned around capability and efficiency. For the first time in the GLM series, we introduce a hybrid architecture combining sparse and linear attention, sharply reducing long-context serving costs while preserving precise long-context capabilities. The model also adopts Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) to further improve scaling efficiency. Together with our latest 30T-token multimodal pre-training corpus, these changes enable GLM-5.3-Flash to deliver more intelligence with less compute.

2026-11-24 06:16:45 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] # Architecture for Extreme Efficiency
2026-11-24 06:16:45 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:16:45 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] ![img_v3_0214u_c34ae85d-2955-4bf5-9102-f22054c6f08g](https://z-cdn-media.chatglm.cn/prompts-rich-media-resources/5.3-flash-blog/HyqVZw2wze.png)
2026-11-24 06:16:45 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:16:45 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] Compared with the GLM-4.5 series, GLM-5.3-Flash is specifically designed for ultra-low-cost inference. Despite a similar total parameter count (320B vs. 355B), it nearly halves both the activated parameter count (18B vs. 32B) and the number of layers (45 vs. 92).
2026-11-24 06:16:45 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:16:45 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] To minimize attention costs in long-context scenarios, we use a hybrid architecture combining linear and sparse attention. Linear attention captures local dependencies through state modeling, while sparse attention retrieves relevant global context through a lightweight indexer. To further reduce the latency and memory overhead of the indexer at a 1M-token context length, we introduce IndexPool, which compresses four indexer key vectors into one through weighted pooling.
2026-11-24 06:16:45 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:16:45 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] To illustrate the efficiency of our architecture, we compare the per-token compute and KV cache size of GLM-5.3-Flash against GLM-5.3 and two recent open models: DeepSeek-V4-Flash and Kimi-K3. For a fair comparison among different scales, we calculate the attention compute per head per layer and average KV cache size per layer (BF16). Compared with GLM-5.3, GLM-5.3-Flash uses 3.0× less attention compute and a 4.4× smaller KV cache. GLM-5.3-Flash has the lowest attention compute among all models compared. The KV cache size is still slightly larger than Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek-V4-Flash, leaving further room for improvement.
2026-11-24 06:16:45 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:16:45 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] The overall architecture improvements, combined with optimized pre-training corpus, enable GLM-5.3-Flash to produce more intelligence with less compute.

It marks the start of Generalized Coding, where code becomes the foundation for solving a much wider range of tasks and unlocking new capabilities:**Loop Transformer Architecture**GLM-5.4 introduces a Loop Transformer architecture that reuses 28 layers of the GLM-5 base model across two iterations, enabling deeper reasoning without increasing parameter count. Combined with optimized KV caching and sparse attention, it delivers stronger reasoning performance while keeping deployment costs under control, particularly at 1M context lengths.**Generalized Coding**Driven by improvements in both coding and vision, GLM-5.4 generalizes well beyond traditional software development. It can write code to generate and edit videos, build complete games, and handle 3D modeling and mechanical design.(↗ Blog)(https://z.ai/blog/glm-5.4)

2026-11-24 06:17:11 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] # The Loop Architecture
2026-11-24 06:17:11 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:17:11 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] !()(https://z-ai-bj.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/prompts-rich-media-resources/5.4-blog/image.png)
2026-11-24 06:17:11 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:17:11 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] As we noted in our GLM-5.3 technical blog, memory-intensive tasks benefit from more parameters, while reasoning-intensive tasks benefit from more effective compute. Large-scale software engineering, cybersecurity, 3D modeling, and physical control are all ultra-long-chain reasoning tasks. The model must follow multi-step causal chains while maintaining global logical consistency. Stacking parameters and memorizing data cannot solve this.
2026-11-24 06:17:11 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:17:11 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] ## From Pre-Trained Base to Loop Transformer
2026-11-24 06:17:11 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:17:11 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] In a standard Transformer, each layer runs once per forward pass. In a Loop Transformer, a group of weight-shared layers runs for multiple iterations, refining the hidden states from the previous pass. This gives us a deeper network without increasing the parameter count.
2026-11-24 06:17:11 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:17:11 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] The idea is not new. The 2018 Universal Transformer proposed weight-shared depth, and recent work on recurrent depth and looped language models has shown gains at small scales. However, while weight sharing improves parameter efficiency, looped models trained from scratch still lag behind unshared models under the same pre-training compute budget. Instead of pre-training from scratch, we adapted an already pre-trained base model into a Loop Transformer through continued training. This lets us raise the intelligence ceiling with a relatively small compute overhead.
2026-11-24 06:17:11 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd]

2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] # GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] [![](https://z-cdn.chatglm.cn/z-blog/z-icon.svg)Chat with it at Z.ai](https://chat.z.ai/) [![](https://z-cdn.chatglm.cn/z-blog/z-icon.svg)Z.ai Coding Plan](https://z.ai/subscribe?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=glm5_launch) [![](https://z-cdn.chatglm.cn/z-blog/z-icon.svg)Code with ZCode](https://zcode.z.ai/)
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] Over the past three months, we have aggressively scaled both loop depth and model size in parallel. The first surprise came from the **Loop Transformer** architecture itself. By executing a shared block of layers across multiple iterations, the model can reason more deeply without adding parameters, effectively matching the performance of much larger models.
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] - **GLM-5.4** is our first flagship model built on the Loop Transformer architecture, reaching intelligence levels comparable to 2T-3T parameter models.
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] - **GLM-5.4** marks the start of **Generalized Coding**, where code becomes the foundation for solving a much wider range of tasks and unlocking new capabilities.
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] The model still has some limitations. Most notably, it tends to get caught in overly long "marathon thinking" loops, though this prolonged reflection and self-correction does consistently improve accuracy beyond its parameter count.
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] # The Loop Architecture
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] ![](https://z-ai-bj.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/prompts-rich-media-resources/5.4-blog/image.png)
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] As we noted in our GLM-5.3 technical blog, memory-intensive tasks benefit from more parameters, while reasoning-intensive tasks benefit from more effective compute. Large-scale software engineering, cybersecurity, 3D modeling, and physical control are all ultra-long-chain reasoning tasks. The model must follow multi-step causal chains while maintaining global logical consistency. Stacking parameters and memorizing data cannot solve this.
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] ## From Pre-Trained Base to Loop Transformer
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] In a standard Transformer, each layer runs once per forward pass. In a Loop Transformer, a group of weight-shared layers runs for multiple iterations, refining the hidden states from the previous pass. This gives us a deeper network without increasing the parameter count.
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] The idea is not new. The 2018 Universal Transformer proposed weight-shared depth, and recent work on recurrent depth and looped language models has shown gains at small scales. However, while weight sharing improves parameter efficiency, looped models trained from scratch still lag behind unshared models under the same pre-training compute budget. Instead of pre-training from scratch, we adapted an already pre-trained base model into a Loop Transformer through continued training. This lets us raise the intelligence ceiling with a relatively small compute overhead.
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] ## Architectural Modifications at 750B Scale
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] GLM-5.4 loops 28 layers of the GLM-5 base model for two iterations. To balance performance gains with deployment costs at the 750B scale, we made three changes after extensive experimentation:
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] #### **Gated Progressive Updates**
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] When converting middle layers of an existing model into a multi-pass loop, directly overwriting hidden states causes activation norms to blow up across iterations. Downstream layers then receive representations outside their expected scale and distribution.
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] GLM-5.4 adds independent per-token gates for each iteration to proportionally write candidate updates back into the residual stream. After training, these gates develop a clear division of labor. The first pass builds global context and writes conservatively with small gate values to keep scales stable. The second pass reuses this state to refine the output, opening the gates to write full updates. The gates also adjust step size dynamically based on token difficulty: on harder tokens, the first pass writes more aggressively so complex predictions benefit more from iterative refinement.
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] #### **Hybrid KV Cache (Global Sharing + Independent Sliding Window)**
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] A naive implementation keeps a full KV cache for every loop iteration, multiplying memory usage with the loop count. Instead, we build on cross-loop KV sharing by supplementing it with a local sliding window for the new pass: the second loop reuses the sparse KV selected in the first pass, while retaining its own newly generated KV within the sliding window. These two KV streams can overlap at the same positions, allowing the model to attend to both the first-pass context representations and the updated local representations from the second pass.
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] As a result, an extra loop only costs one sliding window of KV cache rather than a full context cache. At 1M context lengths, this keeps GLM-5.4âs deployment cost increase over GLM-5.3 well under control.
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] #### **Sparse Attention Index Reuse**
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] GLM-5.4âs base model uses sparse attention. The second loop directly reuses the attention indices generated by the first loop's indexer, adding zero indexing overhead. Our experiments show this performs nearly identically to recomputing indices on every pass.
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] ## Scaling Correctness & Controlled Iso-Parameter Ablations
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] Looping is also a strict test of **Scaling Correctness**: any architectural change must still work at scale. Before committing our flagship model to it, we validated the Loop architecture progressively across 1B, 4B, 30B, and 750B base models.
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] On a 30B model with the exact same architecture as our 750B base, we ran a controlled iso-parameter comparison. With identical parameter counts and only ~10% more total training compute, the looped version showed clear gains:
2026-11-24 06:18:29 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd]

2026-11-24 06:21:01 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] === BLOG 5.4 (key lines)
2026-11-24 06:21:01 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 10:# GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer
2026-11-24 06:21:01 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 14:Over the past three months, we have aggressively scaled both loop depth and model size in parallel. The first surprise came from the **Loop Transformer** architecture itself. By executing a shared block of layers across multiple iterations, the model can reason more deeply without adding parameters, effectively matching the performance of much larger models.
2026-11-24 06:21:01 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 16:- **GLM-5.4** is our first flagship model built on the Loop Transformer architecture, reaching intelligence levels comparable to 2T-3T parameter models.
2026-11-24 06:21:01 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 18:- **GLM-5.4** marks the start of **Generalized Coding**, where code becomes the foundation for solving a much wider range of tasks and unlocking new capabilities.
2026-11-24 06:21:01 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 21:The model still has some limitations. Most notably, it tends to get caught in overly long "marathon thinking" loops, though this prolonged reflection and self-correction does consistently improve accuracy beyond its parameter count.
2026-11-24 06:21:01 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 29:## From Pre-Trained Base to Loop Transformer
2026-11-24 06:21:01 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 31:In a standard Transformer, each layer runs once per forward pass. In a Loop Transformer, a group of weight-shared layers runs for multiple iterations, refining the hidden states from the previous pass. This gives us a deeper network without increasing the parameter count.
2026-11-24 06:21:01 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 33:The idea is not new. The 2018 Universal Transformer proposed weight-shared depth, and recent work on recurrent depth and looped language models has shown gains at small scales. However, while weight sharing improves parameter efficiency, looped models trained from scratch still lag behind unshared models under the same pre-training compute budget. Instead of pre-training from scratch, we adapted an already pre-trained base model into a Loop Transformer through continued training. This lets us raise the intelligence ceiling with a relatively small compute overhead.
2026-11-24 06:21:01 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 35:## Architectural Modifications at 750B Scale
2026-11-24 06:21:01 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 37:GLM-5.4 loops 28 layers of the GLM-5 base model for two iterations. To balance performance gains with deployment costs at the 750B scale, we made three changes after extensive experimentation:
2026-11-24 06:21:01 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 57:Looping is also a strict test of **Scaling Correctness**: any architectural change must still work at scale. Before committing our flagship model to it, we validated the Loop architecture progressively across 1B, 4B, 30B, and 750B base models.
2026-11-24 06:21:01 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 59:On a 30B model with the exact same architecture as our 750B base, we ran a controlled iso-parameter comparison. With identical parameter counts and only ~10% more total training compute, the looped version showed clear gains:
2026-11-24 06:21:01 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 67:- **Longer reasoning chains benefit more.** The largest gains show up in math, scientific reasoning, and long-context tasks, which are core to Generalized Coding.
2026-11-24 06:21:01 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 76:# Generalized Coding
2026-11-24 06:21:01 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 78:Coding has become the foundation for extending model capabilities. Since going all-in on coding in early 2025, we have unlocked Agentic Engineering, Long-Horizon Tasks, and Cybersecurity. Now we are pushing toward **Generalized Coding**. It has a higher ceiling and broader impact, and GLM-5.4 is just the starting point.

2026-11-24 06:21:08 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 14:We introduce GLM-5.3-Flash, the first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series. With 320B total parameters and just 18B active parameters, it outperforms GLM-5.2 across benchmarks and real-world workloads at one-tenth the price, while approaching Claude Opus 4.8 on coding and agentic benchmarks.
2026-11-24 06:21:08 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 16:GLM-5.3-Flash starts from a newly trained base model, with its architecture and training recipe redesigned around capability and efficiency. For the first time in the GLM series, we introduce a hybrid architecture combining sparse and linear attention, sharply reducing long-context serving costs while preserving precise long-context capabilities. The model also adopts Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) to further improve scaling efficiency. Together with our latest 30T-token multimodal pre-training corpus, these changes enable GLM-5.3-Flash to deliver more intelligence with less compute.
2026-11-24 06:21:08 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 26:GLM-5.3-Flash pushes the Pareto frontier of the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.1.1, scoring 57 at just $0.045 per task (discounted) — a level of intelligence previously only available at roughly 10× the cost. This makes it a highly competitive default choice for a broad range of workloads.
2026-11-24 06:21:08 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 30:Across six coding and agentic benchmarks, GLM-5.3-Flash consistently outperforms GLM-5.2, often by a wide margin — 63.4 vs. 46.2 on DeepSWE v1.1 and 48.8 vs. 26.2 on AutomationBench — while approaching Claude Opus 4.8 overall.
2026-11-24 06:21:08 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 34:This holds on our in-house coding evaluation as well: on Z.ai Code Bench v1.0, GLM-5.3-Flash clearly outperforms GLM-5.2 at every effort level, and at max effort nearly matches Claude Opus 4.8 (29.0 vs. 29.5).
2026-11-24 06:21:08 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 42:Compared with the GLM-4.5 series, GLM-5.3-Flash is specifically designed for ultra-low-cost inference. Despite a similar total parameter count (320B vs. 355B), it nearly halves both the activated parameter count (18B vs. 32B) and the number of layers (45 vs. 92).
2026-11-24 06:21:08 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 44:To minimize attention costs in long-context scenarios, we use a hybrid architecture combining linear and sparse attention. Linear attention captures local dependencies through state modeling, while sparse attention retrieves relevant global context through a lightweight indexer. To further reduce the latency and memory overhead of the indexer at a 1M-token context length, we introduce IndexPool, which compresses four indexer key vectors into one through weighted pooling.

Rather than requiring users to explicitly translate their working environment into textual instructions, the model can directly interpret the artifacts associated with a task and identify relevant information. It can also assess its own outputs against the visual context and intended outcome, enabling more effective self-verification and refinement — including stronger judgments of presentation quality and aesthetics.

This calls for aggressive memory optimization, including compute-for-bandwidth and communication-for-bandwidth techniques tailored to the underlying architecture. Our stack combines intra-node tensor parallelism for linear attention and the LM head, ReplaySSM, W8A8 quantization, hybrid INT8/FP8/BF16 cache quantization, and Layer Split.

2026-11-24 06:21:08 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 134:GLM-5.3-Flash incorporates several architectural improvements over GLM-5. For the first time, we introduce a hybrid architecture combining sparse and linear attention, sharply reducing long-context serving costs while preserving precise long-context capabilities. It also adopts Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) to further improve scaling efficiency. Combined with our latest 30T-token multimodal pre-training corpus, these changes let GLM-5.3-Flash produce more intelligence with less compute.Before release, we tested GLM-5.3-Flash anonymously as ox-alpha on OpenCode and OpenRouter to gather user feedback. It quickly became the most popular model of the week — with all of this traffic served on Chinese AI chips.
2026-11-24 06:21:08 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 142:![](https://cloud-document-converter.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/feishu2md/20260826/1787756367780-5fet8o.png)GLM-5.3-Flash is specifically designed for ultra-low-cost inference. Despite a similar total parameter count (320B vs. 355B), it nearly halves both the activated parameter count (18B vs. 32B) and the number of layers (45 vs. 92).To minimize attention costs in long-context scenarios, we use a hybrid architecture combining linear and sparse attention. Linear attention captures local dependencies through state modeling, while sparse attention retrieves relevant global context through a lightweight indexer. To further reduce the latency and memory overhead of the indexer at a 1M-token context length, we introduce IndexPool, which compresses four indexer key vectors into one through weighted pooling.To illustrate the efficiency of our architecture, we compare the per-token compute and KV cache size of GLM-5.3-Flash against GLM-5.3 and two recent open models DeepSeek-V4-Flash and Kimi-K3. For a fair comparison among different scales, we calculate the attention compute per head per layer and average KV cache size per layer (BF16). Compared with GLM-5.3, GLM-5.3-Flash reduces the attention compute and KV cache size by factors of 3.0x and 4.4x. GLM-5.3-Flash has the lowest attention compute among all models compared. The KV cache size is still slightly larger than Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek-V4-Flash, leaving further room for improvement.The overall architecture improvements, combined with optimized pre-training corpus, enable GLM-5.3-Flash to produce more intelligence with less compute. In the table below we show the evaluation results of the base model of GLM-5.3-Flash, comparing with our previous base models and DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base. The results show that GLM-5.3-Flash-Base remains competitive with GLM-5-Base across most benchmarks.
2026-11-24 06:21:08 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 150:Coding capabilities provide an important foundation for intelligent knowledge work, while visual intelligence extends these capabilities to a broader range of professional tasks. 2026-11-24 06:21:08 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 154:Over the past week, we have served GLM-5.3-Flash on a large-scale cluster of Chinese AI chips, supported by a high-bandwidth interconnect and a serving stack optimized for the underlying hardware.To overcome the relatively limited compute and memory capacity of individual chips, we built a dedicated inference engine for this architecture on top of SGLang. Notably, this effort was accelerated by our GLM-5.3-powered infrastructure agent, which assisted engineers in developing and optimizing kernels, diagnosing performance bottlenecks, and improving the serving stack — creating a feedback loop in which the model helped optimize the system serving the model itself.These chips are primarily constrained by memory capacity and bandwidth, especially when supporting context lengths of up to one million tokens. This calls for aggressive memory optimization, including compute-for-bandwidth and communication-for-bandwidth techniques tailored to the underlying architecture. Our stack combines intra-node tensor parallelism for Linear Attention and the LM head, ReplaySSM, W8A8 quantization, hybrid INT8/FP8/BF16 cache quantization, and Layer Split.At cluster scale, our production-grade Encode–Prefill–Decode (EPD) disaggregated architecture separates multimodal encoding, prompt prefill, and token-by-token decoding into independently scheduled and scalable worker pools, enabling efficient and reliable serving across tens of thousands of domestically developed accelerators.Compared with our initial baseline on the same hardware, we achieved a 3× improvement in end-to-end serving performance, reaching hardware efficiency and per-token cost comparable to mainstream NVIDIA GPUs. This demonstrates that Chinese chips can support frontier-model inference efficiently and economically at scale.

2026-11-24 06:23:37 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] # GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer
2026-11-24 06:23:37 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:23:37 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] [![](https://z-cdn.chatglm.cn/z-blog/z-icon.svg)Chat with it at Z.ai](https://chat.z.ai/) [![](https://z-cdn.chatglm.cn/z-blog/z-icon.svg)Z.ai Coding Plan](https://z.ai/subscribe?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=glm5_launch) [![](https://z-cdn.chatglm.cn/z-blog/z-icon.svg)Code with ZCode](https://zcode.z.ai/)
2026-11-24 06:23:37 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:23:37 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] Over the past three months, we have aggressively scaled both loop depth and model size in parallel. The first surprise came from the **Loop Transformer** architecture itself. By executing a shared block of layers across multiple iterations, the model can reason more deeply without adding parameters, effectively matching the performance of much larger models.
2026-11-24 06:23:37 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:23:37 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] - **GLM-5.4** is our first flagship model built on the Loop Transformer architecture, reaching intelligence levels comparable to 2T-3T parameter models.
2026-11-24 06:23:37 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:23:37 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] - **GLM-5.4** marks the start of **Generalized Coding**, where code becomes the foundation for solving a much wider range of tasks and unlocking new capabilities.
2026-11-24 06:23:37 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:23:37 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:23:37 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] The model still has some limitations. Most notably, it tends to get caught in overly long "marathon thinking" loops, though this prolonged reflection and self-correction does consistently improve accuracy beyond its parameter count.

2026-11-24 06:23:37 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] # The Loop Architecture
2026-11-24 06:23:37 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:23:37 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] ![](https://z-ai-bj.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/prompts-rich-media-resources/5.4-blog/image.png)
2026-11-24 06:23:37 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:23:37 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] As we noted in our GLM-5.3 technical blog, memory-intensive tasks benefit from more parameters, while reasoning-intensive tasks benefit from more effective compute. Large-scale software engineering, cybersecurity, 3D modeling, and physical control are all ultra-long-chain reasoning tasks. The model must follow multi-step causal chains while maintaining global logical consistency. Stacking parameters and memorizing data cannot solve this.
2026-11-24 06:23:37 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:23:37 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] ## From Pre-Trained Base to Loop Transformer
2026-11-24 06:23:37 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:23:37 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] In a standard Transformer, each layer runs once per forward pass. In a Loop Transformer, a group of weight-shared layers runs for multiple iterations, refining the hidden states from the previous pass. This gives us a deeper network without increasing the parameter count.
2026-11-24 06:23:37 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:23:37 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] The idea is not new. The 2018 Universal Transformer proposed weight-shared depth, and recent work on recurrent depth and looped language models has shown gains at small scales. However, while weight sharing improves parameter efficiency, looped models trained from scratch still lag behind unshared models under the same pre-training compute budget. Instead of pre-training from scratch, we adapted an already pre-trained base model into a Loop Transformer through continued training. This lets us raise the intelligence ceiling with a relatively small compute overhead.
2026-11-24 06:23:37 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd]

2026-11-24 06:23:37 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] GLM-5.4 loops 28 layers of the GLM-5 base model for two iterations. To balance performance gains with deployment costs at the 750B scale, we made three changes after extensive experimentation:

2026-11-24 06:23:37 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] ## [Navigate to header: Overview](https://docs.z.ai/guides/llm/glm-5.4\#overview) Overview
2026-11-24 06:23:37 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] 
2026-11-24 06:23:37 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] **GLM-5.4** is Z.ai’s latest flagship model and the first built on the Loop Transformer architecture, reaching intelligence levels comparable to 2T-3T parameter models. It marks the start of Generalized Coding, where code becomes the foundation for solving a much wider range of tasks and unlocking new capabilities:**Loop Transformer Architecture**GLM-5.4 introduces a Loop Transformer architecture that reuses 28 layers of the GLM-5 base model across two iterations, enabling deeper reasoning without increasing parameter count. Combined with optimized KV caching and sparse attention, it delivers stronger reasoning performance while keeping deployment costs under control, particularly at 1M context lengths.**Generalized Coding**Driven by improvements in both coding and vision, GLM-5.4 generalizes well beyond traditional software development. It can write code to generate and edit videos, build complete games, and handle 3D modeling and mechanical design.[↗ Blog](https://z.ai/blog/glm-5.4)

2026-11-24 06:29:59 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] <h2 class="section-title" id="glm54-h">GLM-5.4 (released Nov 23, 2026)<span class="new-tag">New</span></h2>
2026-11-24 06:29:59 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] <p>On Nov 23, 2026 Z.ai released <strong>GLM-5.4</strong>, the newest flagship of the GLM family. It is the first model built on a <strong>Loop Transformer</strong>: a shared block of layers runs for multiple iterations, adding reasoning depth without adding parameters. GLM-5.4 loops 28 layers of the GLM-5 base twice and, at 750B scale, reaches what Z.ai describes as intelligence comparable to 2T–3T parameter models. Context length is 1M tokens.</p>
2026-11-24 06:29:59 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] <p>Z.ai frames it as the start of "Generalized Coding", where code becomes the foundation for a wider range of tasks. The company also notes a limitation: the model "tends to get caught in overly long marathon thinking loops", which trades latency and output tokens for accuracy.</p>
2026-11-24 06:29:59 JST [akira/akira/efc1ec2553a940acb51b2d3510d112fd] <p><strong>Pricing status:</strong> as of November 24, 2026 the docs.z.ai pricing table lists no per-token price for GLM-5.4. It is available through the <strong>GLM Coding Plan</strong> and chat.z.ai, and Z.ai's blog lists the API as "Coming Soon". We will add API pricing to this table and to the <a href="/en/pricing/">pricing comparison</a> as soon as Z.ai publishes it.</p>
